text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after we win the Triple Crown, I arrive at my office to find it's become a sea of cardboard boxes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're all congratulatory presents from Seiun Sky's grandfather. There's even a conspicuous box with a fresh sea bream inside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After I leave the room for a moment, I overhear Seiun Sky call her grandfather to say thanks. She sounds happy and tries to get him to baby her a bit.
